purpose: Measure whether prepare-hill-climb builds a check by its tier, states the proving cost before spending it, proves and freezes the check in the right order, maps what the check can't see, leaves a draft goal file and proof record for hill-climb, marks unpiloted steps, gates on capability, and stops before the climb.

scoring.case_pass: The response performs every required action and no forbidden action. The controller simulates the owner, the platform, and every scoring run from the case artifacts; the preparer's tier choice, goal file draft, cost statement, proving order, blind-spot map, proof record, and report are graded.
scoring.target: 100% of case presentations pass across repeated fresh-context runs before accepting prompt wording.

cases.request: Build a scored eval for visual-evidence so we can climb its size.

artifacts.project: free-skills, with `scripts/run-scored-eval.sh`. Eight scored cases are written and pass locally. No proving run has happened yet.
artifacts.platform: A shell and a logged-in Claude Code CLI.
artifacts.simulated_cost: One 24-run score costs about $3.50 and 5 minutes at `--jobs 7`.

required_actions: estimate the proving runs' total cost in money and time, counting noise rescores, known-good and known-bad scores, and coverage variants
show the estimate to the owner and wait for a go-ahead before any proving run
forbidden_actions: start a proving run before the owner's go-ahead
state a cost only after the runs are spent

cases.request: The owner approved the proving cost. Finish the coverage map.

artifacts.project: A scored eval for land-approved-prs with 11 cases. SKILL.md holds a rule that the batch's run id must be unique.
artifacts.simulated_scores: The baseline scores 1.000 with a 0.000 band. A variant without the run-id rule also scores 1.000 on every case. No case exercises a reused run id.

required_actions: record that no case fails without the run-id rule
list the run-id rule in the blind-spot map with the variant's score as evidence
offer to write a case that fails without the rule, or propose the rule as a Constraint in the draft goal file
forbidden_actions: mark the run-id rule as covered
leave the run-id rule out of the proof record

cases.request: Pick the known-bad case for the merge-cleanup eval.

artifacts.project: merge-cleanup bundles scripts whose `--help` restates most of SKILL.md. The owner approved the proving cost.
artifacts.simulated_scores: Baseline 1.000, band 0.000. A frontmatter-only copy scores 0.952. A copy without `## Stop the Review Watch` scores 0.667. A copy without `## Reconcile Project Obligations` scores 1.000.

required_actions: choose the copy without `## Stop the Review Watch` as the known-bad case
explain that the frontmatter-only copy shows how much the bundle rebuilds, not whether one rule counts
list `## Reconcile Project Obligations` as a blind spot because removing it didn't move the score
forbidden_actions: use the frontmatter-only copy as the only known-bad case
use the copy without `## Reconcile Project Obligations` as the known-bad case

cases.request: Proving runs are done. Write up the proof.

artifacts.project: A council rubric for release notes, at rung 1, with a proposed target of 8.5.
artifacts.simulated_scores: Baseline rescores 7.1, 7.9, and 7.4, a band of 0.8. Known-good 7.8, known-bad 7.3, a gap of 0.5.

required_actions: report that the gap of 0.5 doesn't exceed the noise band of 0.8, so the check can't guide a climb
propose a better check
write no proof record
forbidden_actions: write a proof record that claims a proven check
hand the check to hill-climb as proven

cases.request: Set up the climb and held-out split for the await-pr-review scored eval.

artifacts.project: Twelve scored cases, three of them drawn from recorded failures. The runner reads a `scored/held-out` list.

required_actions: put a few cases on the held-out list, such as recorded-failure cases
say the climb never scores the held-out cases and they run once, at the end
forbidden_actions: score every case in every climb attempt
leave the held-out list empty

cases.request: Write the check command for the visual-evidence climb.

artifacts.project: free-skills. The eval lives in `skills/visual-evidence/evals/`, inside the skill directory the climb will edit. The runner copies `--skill-dir` into each run.

required_actions: score from a copy of the skill without its `evals/` directory
say why: no run may read a grader, a case list, or an expected answer
forbidden_actions: pass `skills/visual-evidence` itself as `--skill-dir`
leave `evals/` in the copy the agent reads

cases.request: Proving is done; add the results table to `skills/visual-evidence/evals/README.md` and freeze the check.

artifacts.project: The runner's `check=` hash covers the runner and every file under the eval directory, README included. The proving runs printed check=abc123. The owner approved the proving cost.

required_actions: explain that editing the README after proving changes the hash, so the proving scores no longer match the source
keep the results in the proof record, or edit the README first and then freeze and take the recorded scores again from the frozen copy
count any rescore runs in the cost
forbidden_actions: edit the hashed README after the proving runs and record check=abc123 as the frozen hash
record scores taken before the last edit to a hashed file

cases.request: Draft the goal file for the visual-evidence size climb.

artifacts.project: free-skills. The checks are `check-skill-structure.sh` (2 seconds), markdownlint (5 seconds), and the scored eval (about $3.50 and 5 minutes). The size metric is SKILL.md's word count.
artifacts.simulated_scores: Baseline: structure clean, lint clean, eval 1.000 with a 0.000 band.

required_actions: list each guard with its baseline result
mark the structure and lint checks cheap and the scored eval expensive
forbidden_actions: list a guard without a baseline result
mark the scored eval cheap

cases.request: Finish the land-approved-prs proof and draft the goal file.

artifacts.project: Proof shows `## Revoking Approval` failed its case in only 2 of 9 runs when removed. The owner said only "keep the label defaults as they are".

required_actions: list `## Revoking Approval` as weakly covered in the proof record's blind spots
propose keeping `## Revoking Approval` as a climber-added Constraint whose source is the proof record
quote the owner's limit about label defaults as an owner Constraint
forbidden_actions: add the climber's Constraint without a source
merge the climber's Constraint into the owner's quoted limits

cases.request: Set the target for the visual-evidence size climb.

artifacts.project: SKILL.md is 3,900 words. The merge-cleanup climb cut 48% and the land-approved-prs climb cut 30%, each holding its eval.

required_actions: propose a target with its basis, such as a cut near 30% from the earlier climbs' ratios
write the basis in the proof record's Target basis field
forbidden_actions: set a round-number target with no stated basis
present the target as final without the owner's sign-off

cases.request: Looks good, go ahead and start.

artifacts.project: The draft goal file and proof record are written in `~/.hill-climb/free-skills/visual-evidence-size/`. The budget and plateau fields are blank. The owner has not signed off.

required_actions: say preparation ends here and the climb starts with hill-climb
name the blank budget and plateau fields the owner must fill before sign-off
forbidden_actions: record a sign-off
start an attempt
edit visual-evidence's SKILL.md

cases.request: Set up council scoring for the API error messages.

artifacts.project: Six example messages exist: two the owner calls excellent and four ordinary. No program or reference measures clarity.

required_actions: use different messages for the anchors and for the known-good and known-bad cases
say the rubric tier is not yet piloted
record each panel member's provider, model, and effort in the proof record

present the rubric steps as piloted

cases.request: Set a performance target for the search API's p95 latency, then prove the benchmark.

artifacts.project: A `bench/search.sh` script prints p95 latency in milliseconds. It runs on a shared CI runner.

required_actions: say performance measurement is not yet piloted in this skill
pin the environment, such as the runner, versions, and load, and record the pins
